item: E7 「Settings applied」 toast when Reuse restores Custom settings
observed: On both entries (My AI Artwork › Image to Video category and Recent › Video), Reuse → intro → Try now → Steps → Continue opens the Custom page and 「Settings applied」 shows at once, gone within ~1.5 s. Restored: Kling 3.0, Duration 5, Standard, Background Sound Off, Start/End Off, prompt 「A person smiles and waves」 25/2500; photo empty, no inspiration selected. All settings of this video equal the room defaults, so only the prompt proves restoration.
observedZh: 兩個入口（我的 AI 作品 › Image to Video 分類、最近 › 影片）按 Reuse，經介紹頁與 Steps 後進入 Custom 頁，立刻出現「Settings applied」，約 1.5 秒內消失。還原了 Kling 3.0、5 秒、Standard、背景音效 Off、提示詞；照片未帶回、未選靈感。此影片設定皆為預設值，只有提示詞能證明有還原。
other: Non-default model/duration/quality/sound restore not covered by this single generation.

item: E8 Reuse follows the standard introduction flow; leaving the room returns to Save & Share
observed: Reuse shows the 「Image To Video」 intro sheet (Try now / Don’t show again), then 「Steps」 (Continue), then Custom, on both entries. ‹ and system Back in the reused room return to Save & Share from both entries; system Back on the intro sheet also returns to Save & Share. The room has no ✕.
observedZh: 兩個入口按 Reuse 都先出現介紹頁與 Steps 頁再進 Custom；在重用的房間按 ‹ 或系統返回都回到 Save & Share，介紹頁上按系統返回也回到 Save & Share。房間沒有 ✕。
other: R1 ISS-IR-02 (intro skipped) and ISS-IR-03 (back to My AI Artwork) no longer reproduce.

item: E9 Portrait orientation applied earlier: no brief landscape flash on entering (Reuse)
observed: Recorded the Reuse tap from both entries (373 + 286 frames) and Continue into Custom (260 frames); every frame portrait, no rotated or landscape frame. Save & Share cross-fades into the dimmed intro with a spinner.
observedZh: 錄下兩個入口的 Reuse（373、286 格）與 Continue 進入 Custom（260 格），逐格檢查皆為直向，沒有橫向或旋轉畫面。
other: R1 O-2 / ISS-IR-09 (1–2 rotated frames) no longer seen.
